# Patrick Bartosik: freelance AI Engineer and Full Stack developer in Paris

> Patrick Bartosik is a freelance AI Engineer and Full Stack developer based in Paris, France. He does two jobs: AI engineering (LLM integration, AI agents, RAG) and Full Stack development (SaaS products, website creation and redesign). He works remotely, replies to every request within 24 hours, and the first call is free. The site is available in French, English and Polish.

## Key facts
- Name: Patrick Bartosik
- Role: freelance AI Engineer and Full Stack developer
- Location: Paris, France (remote work, video calls)
- Languages: French (native), Polish (native), English (professional)
- Response time: within 24 hours
- First call: free, no commitment

## AI engineering
- LLM integration: Claude or GPT plugged into an existing product to answer customers or read documents. Typical lead time: 2 to 6 weeks.
- AI agents and automation: an agent that handles a business task from start to finish, such as qualifying a lead or answering support requests. Typical lead time: 4 to 10 weeks.
- RAG and knowledge bases: documents turned into a base that can be queried in plain language, with the source of every answer. Typical lead time: 3 to 8 weeks.

## Full Stack development
- SaaS development: a SaaS from idea to launch, with or without AI (user accounts, subscriptions, dashboard). Typical lead time: 8 to 16 weeks.
- Website development: a custom site built with Next.js, made to load fast and to be found on Google. Typical lead time: 2 to 8 weeks.
- Website redesign: an existing site reworked for speed and search visibility, keeping its URLs and rankings.

## Projects
- TraceGuard: a control layer between AI agents and the tools they call. Every call is allowed, blocked or sent to a person, then written to an exportable audit log. Personal demo, not a commercial product. https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects/traceguard
- NutriCert: a SaaS for restaurant owners (nutrition badges, allergens, QR code and NFC). https://www.nutricert.fr/
- Bookish: a social network for readers, with a Next.js web app and an iOS app. School project. https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects/bookish
- Euroclear France: work on financial market infrastructure (Angular, Azure CI/CD). https://www.euroclear.com/en.html
- Websites built at the W3lead agency: Odaje, Tartine & Chocolat, Qwetch, Easy Clothes, Balzac Paris, Isotoner, Le-1.store.
- All projects: https://patrick.bartosik.fr/projects

## Technologies
- Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Supabase, Prisma
- AI: Claude API, OpenAI API, Azure AI Foundry, Vercel AI SDK, MCP, pgvector, n8n
